finding: Creates the transfer framework: selected former Central Bank assets/liabilities may be transferred to BSP; non-transferred items remain with CB-BOL.
Approves specific transferred assets and liabilities identified in a Committee of Seven report with balance sheets, annexes and schedules; effective 3 Jul 1993.
Continues former Central Bank as CB-BOL to administer and liquidate assets/liabilities not transferred to BSP.
Amends Section 132(b) while retaining the statutory liquidation framework for former Central Bank net liabilities.

source: Philippine Supreme Court — Banco Filipino / CB-BOL jurisprudence
finding: Confirms that BSP and CB-BOL are distinct successor destinations depending on whether the specific former Central Bank asset/liability was transferred or retained.

source: Committee of Seven 50-page transfer schedules and COA audit records
finding: These records are necessary to determine whether any specific TVM-LSM-666-related liability was transferred to BSP, retained by CB-BOL, or otherwise treated.
